title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Night at Convoy of Hope
description: This is a Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope's World Distribution Center, where volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product. Youth ages 10-12 must come with a parent or guardian, and ages 13-17 need signed parental consent; children under 10 are not eligible. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM at One Convoy Drive in Springfield, MO, with volunteers usually arriving around 6 or 6:15 PM.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
